name: Institutional Continuous Monitoring, Reopening and Change Control
objective: Operate the DMRV continuously after period close while controlling source changes, feed interruptions, corrections, reopenings, methodology changes and successor records.
fail_closed: untrusted live feed used for reporting
invariants: live feeds are observations only when provenance and source health permit
feed availability is not data validity
reopening does not erase prior close
change control does not create empirical values
continuous monitoring does not constitute certification or product release
